Four-Paper Semantic Pilot

A sandboxed test of the revised PSED experimental semantics on four papers. Production is untouched: everything here was built from a read-only snapshot, with no API calls and no pipeline stage re-run. ExperimentalCase is a scientifically distinguishable deposition case; figures, panels, curves, plot representations and measurement settings never define one.
